text:
devon: :rotating_light: NYC az1 gpu-pool-a appears to be blackholing traffic — customers getting 502/timeout on infer endpoints. I'm opening a bridge now.
sre-ops: oncall bridge up: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1942000123
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-1942000123 — NYC AZ1 GPU degradation (auto-detected)
nathan: observed intermittent health probes failing on node group gpu-a-*-pods, kernel logs show repeated 'RTE: netlink: route unreachable' around 13:04 UTC.
sam: confirming traffic shift to az2 is in flight via routing policy 'region-fallback:az2'. Some connections are still hitting az1 for sticky sessions.
support-jess: already seeing 7 customer escalations in the queue, pushing a short note to customers affected. Need ETA for status page copy.
product-liz: prioritize hosted customers first then dedicated reserves? we should be explicit on impact levels.
devon: agreed. plan: 1) drain new sessions from az1 2) force-evict unhealthy pods in gpu-pool-a 3) accelerate route reroute/cleanup. Target partial recovery in 20-40m.
sre-ops: running drain script now: ```for node in $(kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-a -o name); do kubectl drain $node --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force; done``` — evictions issued.
nathan: evictions are triggering scaled fallback; metrics show 60% traffic now routed to az2. Latency spiked then stabilized at ~220ms for affected customers.
sam: note — customers with pinned hosts (dedicated) may still see errors until we rotate instances. creating rotation job: J-1942
support-jess: draft status page copy below, please review:
statuspage-bot: ```NYC (az1) GPU Pool Degradation — Partial outage
Impact: Customers in the NYC region may experience request errors (502) and elevated latency. We are routing traffic to a healthy availability zone and performing pod rotations. Estimated time to mitigation: 30-45 minutes. Updates every 15 minutes.``` 
product-liz: change 'estimated time to mitigation' -> 'ETA to mitigation' and call out dedicated customers separately.
support-jess: updated copy:
statuspage-bot: ```NYC (az1) GPU Pool Degradation — Partial outage
Impact: Some customers in the NYC region (hosted + dedicated) may see 502 errors or increased latency. We are actively routing traffic to an alternate AZ and rotating affected instances. ETA to mitigation: 30-45 minutes. Dedicated customers with pinned hosts may require manual host rotation; our team will contact them directly.
Updates: every 15 minutes.``` 
devon: posting to status page now. PR: https://git.redwood/statuspage/prs/523
sre-ops: follow-up: we found a control-plane route table bug causing kernel routes to leak on interface failover. patch landed to autoscaler and control-plane agent (rollout in progress).
nathan: kernel trace snippet: ```RTNETLINK answers: File exists
[13:04:21] route add failed: EEXIST -> duplicate route leak on eth2 after nic-reset``` — correlates with pod recovery windows.
sam: cost note — forced rotations + cross-az traffic will spike egress and transient GPU hours. OPS finance: estimate ~+$3.2k for current window if continues 2h.
product-liz: ok to flag to sales for customers on annual contracts? we should notify any SLAs potentially impacted.
support-jess: I'll escalate to the account teams for two customers in the queue (AcmeCorp & Finlytics).
devon: current status — 85% of traffic healthy, error rate down from 12% -> 1.8%. Evictions completed on all flagged nodes. Control-plane patch rollout ~35% complete.
sre-ops: still seeing a small subset of sticky connections that need manual termination; running force-reset on LB sessions for pool-a.
statuspage-bot: Status update: mitigation in progress. ETA to mitigation still ~20-30 minutes. Next update in 15 minutes.
support-jess: posted to customers + shared in support portal.
product-liz: please note any postmortem action items: improve route table reconciliation on nic-fail, add automatic pinned-host rotation for Dedicated, and extend observability for kernel route leaks.
nathan: logging ticket created: INFRA-1047 (kernel route leak telemetry)
devon: thanks all. keep bridge open until patch fully rolled out and error rate stable <0.5% for 30m.
oncall-bot: Bridge closed at 1942000450 by devon (post-incident monitoring continues).
